messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: finite projective plane PG(2,3) coordinates mapped affinely

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Map the 13 points of PG(2,3) to the unit square by sending the four points of line x=0 to (0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1), the three affine points of line x=1 to (1/2,0),(0,1/2),(1/2,1), and the three of line x=2 to (1,1/2),(1/2,1/2),(1/4,1/4), with the line-at-infinity point [0:1:2] mapped to (3/4,3/4); this configuration has all 286 triangle areas at least 1/32, and no other affine mapping of PG(2,3) to the unit square achieves a larger minimum triangle area."}
